caption: Fig. 8. The overall architecture design. The the basic pipeline is similar to that of GSCore [39], a recent PBNR accelerator. We augment the baseline to support FR (yellow-colored) and to address the workload imbalance issue in PBNR/FR (blue-colored).

templates.why_chosen: Reassigned from baseline-vs-ours by the note-writer: a single three-stage pipeline (Projection, Sorting, Rasterization) over a shared DRAM bus, where two accent colours mark added units against an uncoloured baseline, pipeline emphasis coding, not a two-halves comparison.
templates.what_to_learn: When the contribution is scattered across one pipeline rather than isolated in a second panel, mark each added unit with its own accent colour (here yellow for foveation, blue for load-balancing) against an otherwise uncoloured baseline pipeline, and add an in-figure legend rather than relying on the caption to map colour to purpose.
